newsitem.title: USA: Siemens sets venture with Orbital.
newsitem.headline: Siemens sets venture with Orbital.

text.p: Siemens Automotive and Orbital Engine Corp said Wednesday they will establish a joint venture to develop and sell fuel rail assemblies incorporating Orbital's direct fuel injection technology.
Siemens Automotive is a unit of Siemens AG. No financial terms were announced. The venture will be half owned by each company.
The companies said the rapidly emerging market for direct injection technology in conventional four-stroke automotive engines will be a key application for the venture.
Other markets will be the established U.S. and European non-automotive and growing Asian markets, which are being driven by evolving new emissions regulations.

The venture will be a limited liability company incorporated in Delaware. Orbital's fluid technology unit, based in Saginaw, Mich., will become the product engineering headquarters and will utilize Siemens' existing Newport News fuel systems manufacturing facility in Virginia.
Orbital is based in Perth in Western Australia, with two U.S. operating subsidiaries in Michigan.
